'''Elite Black Sun''' was an exclusive [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] military group serving [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] that fielded [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]], predecessors to the X-wing. The fighter craft of the unit were painted white and marked with Black Sun's logo on the wing panels. The veteran [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] that made up the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] were proud to be flying for the most feared crime syndicate in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Consisting entirely of the best ace [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] in the organization, members were occasionally selected from [[Black Sun Squadron]] based on how effective their ruthless tactics were.
